name: Nokia Corporation
blurb: Nokia is a Finnish telecommunications-equipment maker whose Network Infrastructure division designs optical networking hardware — coherent transceivers, optical line systems, and optical amplifiers — used by carriers and data-centre operators globally. The 2024 acquisition of Infinera, a specialist in coherent digital signal processing and indium phosphide photonic integrated circuits, gave Nokia one of the more vertically integrated optical stacks in the industry.
recent: In March 2026, Nokia launched a suite of AI-era optical solutions including a 1.6T coherent pluggable for data-centre interconnect and a 2.4T pluggable for subsea and terrestrial transport, alongside four new digital signal processors built on both indium phosphide and silicon photonics. Nokia cited up to 70% total-cost-of-ownership savings versus prior-generation products. New line systems are expected in H2 2026; advanced coherent sampling begins mid-2027. At OFC 2026, Nokia emphasised that the Infinera acquisition provides the vertical integration needed to address the widening gap between AI compute and networking capacity.
